name: cublas_cublasSdot_v2
description: Faithfully extracted from KernelGenBench cuBLAS test_cublasSdot_v2.py. Single-precision dot product result = sum(x[::incx][:n]*y[::incy][:n]) via the real cuBLAS baseline (gemm fallback internally). Storage lengths follow the test: len_x=1+(n-1)*incx, len_y=1+(n-1)*incy. result is a preallocated (1,) float32 tensor, fully overwritten (beta=0) and returned. Requires kernelgenbench + cuBLAS at eval time.
